journal:
# Nasser (p21) journal — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04) — scale 169.9 kg
- Welcome screen was friendly. Profile form: the Height/Age/Weight boxes had no example text, just empty boxes with the label above; OK once I found them.
- I picked "Lightly active" (I walk 20 min a day). "No / not sure" for "eating like this 2+ weeks" because I JUST started eating less today.
- Nice surprise: my profile weight 169.9 kg was saved as today's weigh-in automatically, so I didn't have to type it twice.
- Nutrition tab first said "Suggested intake: 3,740 kcal/day" with target "maintain". I was confused — I want to LOSE weight, why is it telling me to eat 3,740?! Nobody asked me my goal in the profile. I had to find the little ⚙ gear on the Nutrition page to pick "Lose". Should be asked in setup.
- After picking Lose (kept default 0.5%/week) it says 2,720 kcal/day, with a message "The math gives 2694 kcal/day, which is below the minimum this app will suggest (2717 — the larger of BMR and 1,500)… expect slower progress". Scary-sounding for me: is 0.5% already too much? I don't really get "BMR". The two numbers 2694 vs 2717 are so close — why even mention it?
- "Protein 162 g — 1.8 g/kg × 90.3 kg reference weight". I weigh 170 kg, what is 90.3 kg?? Nobody explained "reference weight".
- Logging food was easy: label + calories + protein/carbs/fat, "Add entry". Note the "Add entry" words appear twice (heading and button).
- Ate 2,785 today, target 2,720 — a bit over but close. Ticked "Day complete".

## Day 2 (Mon) — scale 169.4 kg
- DOWN 0.5 kg in one day!! Body screen shows "▼ 0.5 kg" under my weight. Very motivating.
- But it also says "Trend weight 169.8 kg". Which one is my weight? 169.4 or 169.8? Not explained on that screen.
- "+ Weight" form was simple. It remembers the time. Fields for body fat / muscle I skip (my scale doesn't show them).
- Logged 4 meals (2,265 kcal, under 2,720 target — good!).
- New yellow note: "2026-10-05: macros add up to ~1920 kcal vs 2265 kcal logged (15% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I copied the numbers from the packets/app I use… I don't know which one is wrong, and I can't fix the label. Made me feel I did something wrong.
- Recommendation still says "(day 1 so far)" even though this is my 2nd day of data. Confusing — did it not count today?

## Day 3 (Tue) — scale 169.0 kg
- 0.9 kg down in 2 days!! Very happy. But "Trend weight" STILL says 169.8 kg, same as yesterday, even though I dropped again. I thought the trend was stuck/broken. Nobody explains what "trend weight" is on the main screen.
- Tapped "Tap for the full breakdown": "needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 0 … BIA with BIA, DEXA with DEXA… Waist is the main fat signal". Too technical. "have 0"?? I have 3 weigh-ins. (I guess it means body-fat readings; my scale has none.) Closed it.
- Ate 3,070 today (kabsa + pasta, oops). The app did not say anything like "you went 350 over today" — I only see "Today 3,070 kcal complete" in the list. There is no "remaining today" number while I eat; I have to do the math myself vs 2,720. For a beginner I would want a simple "left for today".
- Average intake shows 2,707 — so on average I'm OK. Relief.

## Day 4 (Wed) — scale 169.7 kg
- UP 0.7 kg from yesterday :( I got worried: did the kabsa + pasta ruin it? The screen by default says "▼ 0.2 kg" (vs first) so I found the "vs First / vs Last" switch — "vs Last" showed "▲ 0.7 kg" in red-ish. Nothing on the screen told me this is normal water. I'd love a one-line "daily ups and downs are normal" message right there when the scale goes up.
- Opened "Explain the math →" hoping for a simple explanation. It is a wall of formulas: "max(1.5 kg, 3.5 × 1.4826 × MAD)", "Hall 2008 with the Forbes relation", "p = 10.4 ÷ (10.4 + FM)", "Mifflin-St Jeor", "φ = 0.6"… I understood nothing. Also odd spacing: "4 day s", "4 daily weight s used", "( male formula)". A plain-language version is needed for normal people.
- The only thing I did get: "Water / glycogen at the start" — maybe it means the first week drop is partly water?
- Logged 2,561 kcal, under target. Day complete.

## Day 5 (Thu) — scale 167.8 kg
- WOW ▼ 2.1 kg in 4 days!!! I told my brother. At this speed I'll lose 20 kg by winter :D  (Trend weight finally moved: 169.6.)
- But I ate 3,376 kcal today (big lunch + chicken & potatoes). The app said nothing about going over. My average is now 2,811 vs target 2,720 — above target, but no warning or colour. I only noticed because I compared the numbers myself.
- The "macros ... 15% apart" note from Monday is still sitting there on the page days later.

## Day 6 (Fri) — scale 166.8 kg
- ▼ 3.1 kg total in 5 days!!! I'm flying. 
- Trend weight only 169.3 though — the app is much more "careful" than my scale. I found the chart by tapping the "Weight" tile (nothing told me it was tappable, I tried by luck). The chart is nice: dots = my scale, thick line = trend. Text says "exponential moving average, 10% per day" — I don't know what that means, but I can see the thick line is slower. Would be nice if it said in simple words "the thick line smooths out daily water ups and downs".
- Logged 2,333 kcal, under target. Good day.

## Day 7 (Sat) — scale 167.4 kg
- Up 0.6 from yesterday, but still ▼ 2.5 kg for the week. Trend 169.1. I'm starting to understand the scale goes up and down.
- 2,810 kcal today (pizza again…). Weekly average 2,743.

## Week 1 (checked Sat 2026-10-10, before the Sunday update)
- App shows: maintenance 3,740 ± 880 kcal/day, "ESTIMATED", "0% from your data". Target 2,720 kcal/day ("lose · 0.5%/wk · at minimum"). Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 2,720 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)." Warning about 2694 vs minimum 2717. Macro-mismatch note from 10-05. Body composition: "Not enough data yet".
- What I understand: my body burns about 3,700 a day, I should eat about 2,700 to lose. The app is not sure yet (the ± 880 is huge — could be 2,900 or 4,600?). "day 1 so far" is still written after 7 days, which makes me think the app hasn't counted my week. It says it updates Sunday, so I'll check tomorrow.
- Decision: I'm at 2,743 average, basically on target. I'll keep eating like this, maybe a little less pizza. Wait for tomorrow's update before changing anything.

## Week 1 update (Sun 2026-10-11, day 8, after the app's weekly update)
- Now: maintenance 3,850 ± 860 (Estimated, 5% from your data). Target 2,820 kcal/day "lose · 0.5%/wk" (the "at minimum" warning is gone). Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 2,820 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)." Weight change -2.15 kg/week (95%: -3.51 to -0.78). Protein averaged 152 g vs 162 g target.
- My reaction: Wait — I lost 2.5 kg this week and the app RAISED my calories by 100? That feels backwards. I'm losing way faster than the 0.5%/week (~0.85 kg) I chose, and nobody tells me whether that is good, too fast, or just water. A simple sentence like "Your first week drop is mostly water, expect slower from now" would really help me.
- Decision: I'm eating ~2,740 on average, already under the 2,820. I won't eat more — I'm happy with how fast it's going. No change to my plan.
- From today I use my small routine script (runday.mjs) that types my weigh-in and meals into the app for me, then I look at the screens after each week.

## Days 9–14 (routine script)
- Day 9 I ate 3,692 (oats + shawarma + mandi, family dinner). Day 10 the scale went UP to 167.8 — I panicked a bit. Then 166.8, 166.8, 165.8 (new low!), 166.3.
- The app screens stayed the same all week (numbers only update Sundays), only the avg intake and protein note changed. Nothing new popped up, no warning even though my average went above the target.

## Week 2 (Sat 2026-10-17, day 14)
- App shows: maintenance 3,850 ± 860 (Estimated, 5% from data). Target 2,820 (lose 0.5%/wk). Recommendation: "Suggested intake 2,820 kcal/day. On-track check needs 14 days (day 8 so far)". Avg intake 2,891 (7 of 7 days complete). -2.15 kg/week (still last Sunday's number). Protein 152 g vs 162 g target. Body: 166.3 kg, ▼ 3.6 kg total, trend 167.9.
- What I understand: I'm eating ~70 kcal a day more than the target. And this week I only lost ~1.1 kg compared to 2.5 kg the first week. I'm worried it's slowing down already!! The app did not say anything about the slow-down or about me being over target — I had to figure it out myself.
- Decision: be stricter. Aim for ~2,700 a day (a bit under the 2,820 target) — fewer pizza nights, and add a bit more protein (the app says I'm under the protein target).

## Week 2 update (Sun 2026-10-18, day 15, after the app's update) — scale 165.3, ▼ 4.6 kg total!
- New recommendation (screenshot screens/1790460453936.png): "Your estimated rate (−2.38 kg to −1.16 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −0.84 kg/week. Eating about 1,140 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 3,110 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 4,140 ± 770 (Estimated, 24% from data). Target 3,110. Rate -1.77 kg/week. Avg intake 2,897.
- I was SHOCKED. Eat 1,140 MORE per day?? That would be like 4,000 a day — that's more than I ate before the diet! But then the same box says 3,110, which is only ~200 more than what I eat now. Which one is it? The two numbers don't match (2,897 + 1,140 ≈ 4,040, not 3,110). In "Explain the math" I found the 1,140 is from my "measured rate" and the 3,110 is from "maintenance 4,137 − 1,025". For me these are two different answers in the same sentence.
- Also I feel a bit punished: I'm finally losing weight and the app says "doesn't include your target" like I'm failing. It never says "great job, you're losing faster than planned".
- I also finally understood "90.3 kg reference weight" (it's the weight at BMI 25 for my height) — but only inside Explain the math.
- Decision: I just planned 2,700 yesterday. I'm scared to eat a lot more and stop the loss. I'll compromise: go back to my normal ~2,900 (still under the 3,110 suggestion), not 4,000.

## Week 3 (Sat 2026-10-24, day 21)
- Scale this week: 165.6, 165.8, 165.8, 165.0, 165.8, 165.7. STUCK. A whole week without going down. Total ▼ 4.2 kg (was 4.6 last Sunday). Trend 166.7.
- I ate more (avg 3,009, some days 3,200+) because the app told me to eat more… and now the loss stopped. I'm worried and a little angry: did the app's advice make me stop losing?
- App screen is exactly the same as last Sunday (updates weekly): still "rate −2.38 to −1.16 kg/week doesn't include your target… eat about 1,140 more… Suggested 3,110". It still tells me I'm losing too FAST while my scale hasn't moved for a week. That feels wrong and doesn't calm me down. No message about plateaus being normal.
- Protein line now says "average of 4 complete day(s) with protein logged" although all 7 days were complete — I don't know why only 4 count.
- Decision: wait for tomorrow's Sunday update before changing anything.

## Week 3 update (Sun 2026-10-25, day 22) — scale 165.3
- Now it says "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.42 kg to −0.43 kg per week) includes your target of −0.83 kg/week. Suggested intake: 3,060 kcal/day." Maintenance 4,080 ± 610, label changed from ESTIMATED to MEASURED (52% from your data). Rate -0.93 kg/week. Avg intake 3,001. Protein 160 / 162 g.
- "On track" — finally a clear, simple, happy message! That calmed me down after the stuck week. The word "Measured" also makes me trust the numbers more.
- Still, it didn't mention my plateau at all; I'd like to hear "a flat week is normal".
- Decision: I'm eating ~3,000, suggestion is 3,060. Keep doing exactly what I do. No change.

## Week 4 (Sat 2026-10-31, day 28)
- Scale: 164.8, 165.0, 163.2 (!!! new low), 163.7, 164.7, 164.4. Total ▼ 5.5 kg, trend 165.5. The 163.2 made my day, then it jumped back up +1.5 in two days and I got nervous again.
- App (same as last Sunday): On track, suggested 3,060, maintenance 4,080 ± 610 Measured. Avg intake 3,032. Protein 161/162.
- My understanding: I'm doing fine. The daily jumps are water (I'm learning this from the chart; the app itself never says it in simple words on the main screen).
- Decision: continue, no change.

## Week 4 update (Sun 2026-11-01, day 29) — scale 163.8
- "On track. Estimated rate (−1.40 to −0.64 kg/week) includes your target of −0.83. Suggested intake: 3,260 kcal/day." Maintenance 4,260 ± 470, Measured, 72% from data. Rate -1.02 kg/week. Avg intake 3,043.
- It keeps raising my number every week (2,720 → 2,820 → 3,110 → 3,060 → 3,260). Strange feeling for a diet app. But it says "On track" and I'm losing ~1 kg/week, so I'm happy. I won't eat more than I do now (~3,000); losing a bit faster than 0.83 is fine by me.
- Decision: no change.

## Week 5 (Sat 2026-11-07, day 35)
- Scale: 164.1, 164.7, 163.7, 164.9, 164.6, 163.5. Going sideways most of the week, then 163.5 today. Total ▼ 6.4 kg. Honestly the first week (−2.5 kg) spoiled me; now it's slow and bumpy and I keep worrying.
- From day 31 a banner appeared on top: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". Today I tapped "Back up now" → "Your data" page → "Full backup (JSON)". A file downloaded (bodytracker-backup-2026-11-07.json) and it now says "Last backup: 2026-11-07". Easy. "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — no idea what that means or what I should do about it.
- App (still last Sunday's update): On track, suggested 3,260, maintenance 4,260 ± 470 (Measured, 72%). Avg intake 2,949.
- Decision: stay the course (~3,000/day). Wait for tomorrow's update.

## Week 5 update (Sun 2026-11-08, day 36) — scale 165.5 (UP 2 kg from yesterday!!)
- I almost cried this morning. +2 kg overnight. The Body screen just shows ▼ 4.4 kg now instead of ▼ 6.4; no calming message.
- Nutrition: "On track. Estimated rate (−1.03 to −0.43 kg/week) includes your target of −0.82. Suggested intake: 2,890 kcal/day." Maintenance dropped to 3,900 ± 370 (Measured, 83%). Rate -0.73 kg/week. Avg intake 2,903.
- My understanding: the app now thinks I burn less than before (4,260 → 3,900), so it lowered my number to 2,890. Still says "On track", which helps. But my loss rate is slowing (−2.15 → −1.77 → −0.93 → −1.02 → −0.73). That worries me.
- Decision: follow the new number and go a bit under it: ~2,850/day.

## Week 6 (Sat 2026-11-14, day 42)
- Scale: 164.8, 164.2, 164.2, 165.6, 164.7, 163.7. Bumpy again, ended at 163.7.
- I slipped this week: I wanted 2,850 but had several 3,200–3,700 days (family dinners, Friday). Avg intake 3,101 vs target 2,890. The app shows the numbers but says NOTHING — still "On track" in the big box from last Sunday. I wish it would gently say "this week you're 200 over your target" so I can catch myself mid-week.
- Decision: recommit to ~2,850. Wait for Sunday update.

## Week 6 update (Sun 2026-11-15, day 43) — scale 164.0
- "On track. Estimated rate (−0.90 to −0.30 kg/week) includes your target of −0.82. Suggested intake: 2,780 kcal/day." Maintenance 3,780 ± 360 (Measured, 84%). Rate -0.60 kg/week. Avg intake 3,090.
- It says "On track" but my rate keeps sliding (−0.60 now, target −0.82) and I'm eating 300 above its suggestion. The words "On track" and my feeling don't match — I think I'm drifting. The app is too nice here; for a beginner I need it to say clearly "you're eating ~300 over; cut back to 2,780".
- Maintenance keeps going down each week (4,260 → 3,900 → 3,780). I guess because I'm getting lighter?
- Decision: follow the new number properly: 2,750/day.

## Week 7 (Sat 2026-11-21, day 49)
- Scale: 163.3, 163.6, 163.2, 162.8 (new low!), 164.2, 163.9. Ugh, the Friday jump again.
- Ate better: avg intake 2,716, under the 2,780 target. Proud of that. App shows a note "Protein averaged 142 g on 6 logged day(s) vs a 162 g target" — OK, I'll try more eggs/chicken.
- App same as last Sunday (On track, 2,780, maintenance 3,780 ± 360 Measured).
- Decision: keep ~2,750, add protein.

## Week 7 update (Sun 2026-11-22, day 50) — scale 162.4 (NEW LOW, ▼ 7.5 kg!)
- "On track. Estimated rate (−0.96 to −0.44 kg/week) includes your target of −0.82. Suggested intake: 2,780 kcal/day." Maintenance 3,780 ± 310 (Measured, 88%). Rate -0.70 kg/week. Avg 2,805.
- Happy day. The number didn't change this week, which I like — simple. Rate went back up a little (−0.60 → −0.70) after I ate better. I can see the connection now.
- Decision: keep ~2,750.

## Week 8 (Sat 2026-11-28, day 56)
- Scale: 161.9 (first time under 162!), 162.8, 162.7, 163.7, 163.1, 162.9. The drop on Monday then back up… I'm used to it a bit by now but it still stings.
- Ate well: avg 2,640 (under 2,780). Protein 148 vs 162 — still under.
- App unchanged since Sunday. Nothing new popped up.
- Decision: continue.

## Week 8 update (Sun 2026-11-29, day 57) — scale 163.2
- "On track. Estimated rate (−1.15 to −0.08 kg/week) includes your target of −0.82. Suggested intake: 2,750 kcal/day." Maintenance 3,750 ± 330 (Measured, 86%). Rate -0.61. Avg intake 2,586. Protein 139 / 162.
- This one confused me. I ate LESS than it asked (2,586 vs 2,780) and my rate went DOWN (−0.70 → −0.61), and the scale is higher than last Sunday (162.4 → 163.2). And still "On track"?? The range "−1.15 to −0.08" is huge — −0.08 is basically nothing. How can nearly-zero loss be "on track"? I feel like "On track" is always shown no matter what.
- Decision: I'm already under the 2,750 suggestion, so I won't cut more (I'm hungry already). Keep going, try hard to hit the protein target, and hope it moves.

## Week 9 (Sat 2026-12-05, day 63)
- Scale: 162.9, 162.0, 161.9, 161.0 (!!! lowest ever), 162.1, 162.4. So it IS moving, slowly. 161.0 made me dance.
- Avg intake 2,681 (under 2,750). Protein note: 140 g "on 5 logged day(s)". App unchanged since Sunday; nothing new popped up.
- Decision: continue.

## Week 9 update (Sun 2026-12-06, day 64) — scale 162.6
- "On track. Estimated rate (−1.18 to −0.15 kg/week) includes your target of −0.81. Suggested intake: 2,740 kcal/day." Maintenance 3,720 ± 320 (Measured, 87%). Rate -0.66. Avg 2,640. Protein 136 / 162.
- New note: "2026-12-06: macros add up to ~2801 kcal vs 2331 kcal logged (20% apart)". I typed exactly what the packets/app said. I still don't know which number to fix, so I leave it.
- The suggestion changes by tiny amounts each week now (2,780 → 2,750 → 2,740). Fine, simple.
- Decision: keep ~2,700. Still under on protein; the app keeps reminding me but doesn't say how (e.g., "add a chicken breast").

## Week 10 (Sat 2026-12-12, day 70)
- Scale: 162.7, 161.8, 163.4, 163.2, 162.8, 162.3. Three weeks now between 161 and 163.7. I'm honestly getting discouraged. At the start I lost 2.5 kg in a week; now 3 weeks for maybe 1 kg.
- Avg intake ~2,700 (close to the 2,740 suggestion). App unchanged since Sunday, still "On track".
- The backup reminder came back on 12-07 (30 days after my last backup). Tapped "Back up now" → "Full backup (JSON)" again → bodytracker-backup-2026-12-12.json. Good reminder.
- Decision: wait for tomorrow's update. If it still says on track I'll trust it, but I wish it told me what "normal" speed looks like at this stage.

## Week 10 update (Sun 2026-12-13, day 71) — scale 162.0, ▼ 7.9 kg total
- "On track. Estimated rate (−1.02 to −0.47 kg/week) includes your target of −0.81. Suggested intake: 2,640 kcal/day." And the old warning is back: "The math gives 2623 kcal/day, which is below the minimum this app will suggest (2644 — the larger of your estimated BMR and 1,500). Target set to 2644; expect slower progress than the chosen rate." Maintenance 3,610 ± 320 (Measured, 87%). Rate -0.75. Avg 2,681.
- "at minimum" + "expect slower progress" sounds like bad news to me. Does it mean I've reached the lowest I'm allowed to eat and it will only get slower from here? I'm 162 kg, I feel I still have a long way to go. Also a bit funny: the box says "2,640" but the warning says "2,644".
- The rate went up to −0.75 though, and "On track", so I'm less worried than yesterday.
- Decision: follow it: ~2,650/day.

## Week 11 (Sat 2026-12-19, day 77)
- Scale: 161.7, 162.1, 160.8, 159.9 (!!!!! UNDER 160 for the first time in years), 161.4, 161.0. I screenshotted 159.9 and sent it to my family.
- Ate ~2,450 avg this week, under the 2,640. Another "macros … 17% apart" note for 12-19. Protein 143/162.
- App unchanged since Sunday. Nothing new popped up — no celebration for passing 160, which I would have loved (a small "new lowest weight!" would mean a lot to someone like me).
- Decision: continue.

## Week 11 update (Sun 2026-12-20, day 78) — scale 160.0, ▼ 9.9 kg total!!
- "On track. Estimated rate (−1.15 to −0.62 kg/week) includes your target of −0.81. Suggested intake: 2,660 kcal/day." Maintenance 3,640 ± 310 (Measured, 87%). Rate -0.89 kg/week (best since week 2). Avg intake 2,470. The "at minimum" warning is gone.
- Almost 10 kg! Eating less these two weeks really moved the scale. The app's "rate" number going up (−0.75 → −0.89) made me feel rewarded.
- Decision: keep ~2,650 (matches the 2,660 suggestion).

## Week 12 (Sat 2026-12-26, day 84) — scale 157.2, ▼ 12.7 kg total!!!
- Scale: 159.9, 161.1, 160.0, 159.4, 157.9, 157.2. Big drops at the end. Trend 160.5.
- App (from last Sunday): On track, suggested 2,660, maintenance 3,640 ± 310 Measured (87%), rate −0.89 kg/week. Avg intake 2,824 this week (a few 3,000+ days). Protein 163/162 — finally hit it.
- Body composition card still "Not enough data yet" after 12 weeks (I have no body-fat scale and never measured tape). It never really told me in simple words "measure your waist to unlock this".
